title: Xaasidkii Baaba'ay
intro: Sheeko ka weyn boqortooyo ama qorniinka - masiibadii ugu horreysay ee aadanaha oo ka dhalatay hinaaso. Hal naf, oo ka weyn laba carruur ah oo ay dhaleen waalidkii ugu horreeyay, ayaa si cadho leh u daawanaysay iyadoo walaal ka yar uu helay raallinimo la diiday. Waxa xigay waxay ahayd doorashadii ugu mugdiga badnayd, taasoo ka tagtay dhiiggii ugu horreeyay ee abid dhulka lagu daadiyo. Ma soo bandhigi kartaa aqoonsiga, tijaabada, iyo qoomamada qadhaadh?
clues: Waxaan ka dhashay labadii aadane ee ugu horreeyay ee dhulka ku dul socday.
Mar ayaan Alle u soo bandhigay allabari, laakiin igama aqbalin.
Dalabka walaalkay waa la aqbalay, halka kanygiina la diiday—wax aanan u adkaysan karin.
Waxaan noqday qofkii ugu horreeyay ee dil ka geysta dhulkan, anigoo dilay walaalkay.
Ilaahay wuxuu soo diray xayawaan dhulka ka mid ah - shimbir madow oo dhulka qodaysa - si uu ii baro sida loo qariyo waxa aan sameeyay, waxaana iga haray wax aan ka ahayn qoomamo.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Iyada oo ilmo yar ah oo webi ku jira ayaa laga tagay
Waxaa lagu tijaabiyay boqortooyo aad u weyn
Waxaa la amray in la allabaryo wiilkiisa

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxaa ka buuxay qoomamo iyo kuwa khasaaray
Dhulka ayaa lagu liqay iyadoo ay la socdaan khasnado
Wuxuu noqday rasuul Alle oo sharaf leh
Jannada waxay ku gashay naxariista rabbaaniga ah
Waxay ka talin jirtay boqortooyo aan la barbar dhigi karin
outcome.answer: Waxaa ka buuxay qoomamo iyo kuwa khasaaray

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
